row_granularity: one individual workers' compensation claim represented by a repeated claim-detail block
notes: The report contains repeated three-page policy blocks. Claim details begin on PDF page 2 and resume for a second policy block on PDF page 5; the supplied pages stop before the second block's final page. Policy Number, Policy Period, Agent, Insured, and Valued as of appear in the block header rather than on each claim. Each claim block contains Cause and Accident Description, followed by a nested financial matrix with Paid, Reserved, and Total Incurred headings and Medical, Indemnity, Loss Adj. Expense, Rehab, Subrogation, and Total rows. Policy summaries also contain Paid Loss Adjustment Expenses, Outstanding Losses and Expenses, and Total Incurred Losses and Expenses. The source uses Date of Injury rather than an allowed Accident Date label. Per-block summaries show claim counts of 2 and 3, but no single report-wide claim-row count is stated on the supplied pages.
